items.label: Open connections per person
items.description: How many live connections (browser tabs) one person may have open at once.
items.long_description: A tab that is closed frees its place. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Live topics per connection
items.description: How many live topics (channels, inboxes) one connection may be on at once.
items.long_description: Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Events per second from a browser
items.description: How many small signals (such as "is typing") one connection may send each second; more are dropped.
items.long_description: Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Close a silent connection after (seconds)
items.description: A connection that answers neither messages nor the server's checks for this long is closed; the browser reconnects.
items.long_description: Between 10 and 3600. Organizations can override the global default.
